Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence manifest and metadata fields for onboarding

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for taking this onboarding. Attached is our initial evidence manifest (CSV) that maps artifacts we plan to surface in the vendor portal. A couple of asks from our side:

- Can Redwood ingest the manifest as-is, or do you need a specific set of metadata columns? (We currently have: filename, artifact_type, evidence_scope, created_at, retention_days, checksum_sha256.)
- We need a short-lived S3 presign flow for bulk uploads (3 hour presign validity). Is there any restriction on the presign TTL on your side?
- VaultSecure will provide a KMS key fingerprint for verification and an executed NDA (attached). We also need a confirmed IP allowlist for the upload service.

Attachments: evidence_manifest_vaultsecure.csv, nda-vaultsecure-signed.pdf, kms_key_fingerprint.txt

Goal: get a mapping decision and an upload window this week so we can seed the portal with a first pass of artifacts (~1.2k items).

Thanks,
Laura Chen

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence manifest and metadata fields for onboarding

Laura,

Appreciate the manifest — this is a good starting point. Quick answers up front:

- Ingest: We can accept your CSV columns but recommend adding two optional metadata fields: "signature_hash" (signed artifact fingerprint) and "evidence_category" (SIG/CAIQ/SOC2). Those help downstream mapping for automated checks.
- Presign TTL: 3 hours is fine for a one-off bulk load. For repeated syncs we recommend 15m presigns + multipart streaming. We'll coordinate a short-lived service account.
- IP allowlist: please send the CIDR(s). We will add them to our upload gateway and share the final list.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Laura sends the CIDR and confirms the retention_days policy for each artifact class.
2) Ben will provision an S3 presign role and share the upload manifest template.
3) Rishi will validate the KMS key fingerprint and return a signed confirmation for your SOC 2 auditor.
4) We'll schedule a 45-minute handoff today or tomorrow to agree on the mapping and target upload window.

I've looped in Laura B and Ben to take the technical pieces.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0133

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@vaultsecure.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence manifest and metadata fields for onboarding

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the manifest. A few technical notes and an attachment (redwood_whitelist_ips.xlsx) with our upload gateway addresses:

1) Metadata: we'll accept your columns. Please add the two optional columns Stephanie mentioned: signature_hash and evidence_category. Example values:
   - signature_hash: SHA256:3f7a...
   - evidence_category: CAIQ / SOC2 / SIG

2) Presign policy: we will create an IAM role that issues presigned PUTs scoped to the manifest-prefix you provide. We'll honor the 3-hour TTL for this bulk load. For the bulk run, please ensure each object upload includes the checksum header x-amz-meta-checksum (sha256).

3) KMS verification: we received kms_key_fingerprint.txt — Rishi will validate thumbprint. If it's an external-managed key we will need the key ARN and a short-lived token exchange for verification.

4) Retention and TTL: our evidence retention defaults to 540 days; if you have classes that require longer or shorter retention please annotate retention_days per-row.

5) Attachments & manifest: we made a small template change to the manifest to include "portal_path" (where we'll place the item in the portal catalog). See attached whitelist for our egress IPs; once you confirm your CIDR(s) we'll flip the rule to allow uploads.

Proposed upload window: Wed 19 Jul 2028, 09:00-12:00 PT (three-hour window) — that aligns with our team availability to absorb any rate backoffs. Can you confirm?

Attachments: redwood_whitelist_ips.xlsx

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Security Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
